generation_metric: wall-clock audio preparation through RGB transfer; includes final padded generation; excludes encode/mux; AGGREGATE over concurrent sessions (useful_fps = sessions x frames / wall)

runs.stage_seconds_note: per-session CUDA event spans; DiT/audio/encode on the session's stream, vae_decode on the shared decode stream; sessions overlap, so the sums exceed wall time by design

sampling_schedule.seed_comparability: seeds are NOT comparable across step counts: a fresh full randn is drawn per step, so the generator stream differs. Compare distributions.

sessions.mode: one CUDA stream per session, round-robin issue, one window in flight per session
